name: Marlin Stutzman
stance: Places responsibility for AI harms on the companies building it rather than government, and rejects AI doomsday warnings.

statements.text: The responsibility of ensuring that no human being is harmed by the advancement of AI is directly on these tech companies that are producing it.
I’ll take Jensen’s opinion over a random AI whistleblower any day of the week. The world isn’t ending, AI companies just need to learn responsibility when it comes to their own products.
Government shouldn’t have to be responsible for the kill switch.
